properties.destination: Public repo oskarhane/agent-harness tagged v1 holds the complete harness-init.sh scaffold (both reusable workflows, opencode policy, reviewer agent, command, 6 prompts, README) with fireworks-ai/kimi-latest as default model and fireworks-ai/deepseek-flash-latest for implement + small roles.
properties.context: OVERVIEW.md + SETUP.md in this directory specify a Linear-triggered coding agent; this graph executes the scriptable part of SETUP.md (Phase 2). Phase 1 prerequisites are manual and not yet done, so onboarding (Phase 3) and the smoke test (Phase 4) are deferred.
out_of_scope: Phase 1 manual prerequisites: GitHub App creation + .pem key + installation on repos, Linear API key, Linear PR automations, Fireworks API key
Phase 3: onboarding any target repo with agent-onboard.sh
Phase 4: smoke test with a throwaway Linear card
Editing harness content beyond what harness-init.sh generates

properties.text: oskarhane/agent-harness is a public GitHub repo and tag v1 points at the harness-init scaffold commit

gh workflow list on the repo shows both reusable workflows registered and active (by path or by name — GitHub reports never-run reusable workflows by path), and the workflow YAML at tag v1 declares 'name: agent (reusable)' and 'name: agent-ci-fix (reusable)' — i.e. GitHub accepted the workflow YAML

Model routing is pinned in the generated files: fireworks-ai/kimi-latest as the workflow's model default, fireworks-ai/deepseek-flash-latest as implement-model default and as small_model in opencode.jsonc
All expected harness files exist: 2 reusable workflows, opencode/opencode.jsonc, opencode/agents/gbuild-reviewer.md, opencode/commands/agent-task.md, prompts 01-05 + ci-fix, README.md

properties.title: Run harness-init.sh to scaffold and publish the harness repo

input.preconditions: gh authenticated as oskarhane; oskarhane/agent-harness does not exist yet; ~/src/agent-harness absent or empty; git user identity configured

output.commit_sha: <40-char sha that tag v1 points at, from git -C <dir> rev-parse v1>
files: <relative path of every file the script wrote>

acceptance: git -C ~/src/agent-harness rev-list --count HEAD prints 1, and git -C ~/src/agent-harness rev-parse v1 prints the same 40-char sha recorded in output.commit_sha
gh repo view oskarhane/agent-harness --json visibility -q .visibility prints PUBLIC

the scaffolded dir contains .github/workflows/agent.yml, .github/workflows/agent-ci-fix.yml, opencode/opencode.jsonc, opencode/agents/gbuild-reviewer.md, opencode/commands/agent-task.md, prompts/01-plan.md, prompts/02-implement.md, prompts/03-review.md, prompts/04-fix.md, prompts/05-pr.md, prompts/ci-fix.md and README.md

properties.title: Verify scaffolded files and model routing on disk
acceptance: .github/workflows/agent.yml contains the literal strings 'default: "fireworks-ai/kimi-latest"' (the model input) and 'default: "fireworks-ai/deepseek-flash-latest"' (the implement-model input)

opencode/opencode.jsonc matches grep -F for all of: '"small_model": "fireworks-ai/deepseek-flash-latest"', '"subagent_depth": 2', 'opencode-gbuild@0.4.0', '"gbuild-reviewer"', '"write": false', '"edit": false'

grep -F '__LINEAR_ID__' prompts/01-plan.md and grep -F 'NEEDS-CLARIFICATION' prompts/01-plan.md both match; grep -F 'Fixes __LINEAR_ID__' prompts/05-pr.md matches; grep -F '[agent-ci-fix]' prompts/ci-fix.md matches

.github/workflows/agent.yml contains 'workflow_call:', 'environment: agent', and 'required: true' for each of AGENT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, FIREWORKS_API_KEY, LINEAR_API_KEY; .github/workflows/agent-ci-fix.yml contains 'workflow_call:' and 'default: 3'
README.md contains the literal 'Current defaults: model `fireworks-ai/kimi-latest`, opencode `2.0.1`, opencode-gbuild `0.4.0`'
output.all_passed is true and output.checks contains one entry per check run, each with a passed flag

properties.title: Verify the GitHub repo, tag and workflow discovery
acceptance: gh api repos/oskarhane/agent-harness/git/refs/tags/v1 --jq .object.sha prints exactly the scaffold node's output.commit_sha

gh workflow list --repo oskarhane/agent-harness --all shows both workflows registered and active (identified by path or by name), and the workflow YAML at tag v1 declares 'name: agent (reusable)' and 'name: agent-ci-fix (reusable)'
gh api 'repos/oskarhane/agent-harness/contents/prompts/01-plan.md?ref=v1' --jq .name prints 01-plan.md (file content exists at the tag)
gh repo view oskarhane/agent-harness --json isPrivate -q .isPrivate prints false
output.all_passed is true and output.workflow_names lists the workflows gh discovered
